explication: This repository is a local Tavily MCP server: an MCP client invokes a registered tool, the server dispatches the request to a Tavily operation, and formats the returned data for the client. The README also documents search, extract, map, and crawl, all exposed through the sampled server entry point. Source excerpts are partial, so the graph omits uncertain configuration and authentication wiring.
